tasks.title: Recover accuracy logs and compute per-run accuracy
tasks.objective: Sort generator.log and judge.log by timestamp, assign to 3 runs per question_id, save per-run JSONL files and compute accuracy

factSources.description: Two input log files at /app/raw_logs/generator.log and /app/raw_logs/judge.log, each with 30 events containing timestamp, question_id, prediction/target fields.

outputContracts.description: Generate 7 output files: 6 per-run JSONL files (run_{1..3}_generator.jsonl, run_{1..3}_judge.jsonl) each with 10 lines sorted by timestamp, and results.json with per-run accuracy computed after excluding error events. JSONL must use compact format with no extra whitespace. results.json must follow the schema with correct, total, accuracy (or null).

maps.title: Recover accuracy logs and compute per-run accuracy

nodes.title: Inspect log files
nodes.contextSummary: Read generator.log and judge.log to understand structure and content before processing

nodes.title: Implement log recovery and accuracy computation
nodes.contextSummary: Write and run Python script to: (1) read from W:\app\task_deps, (2) group by question_id, sort by timestamp, assign runs, (3) save 6 JSONL files to W:\app\recovered_logs\, (4) compute accuracy excluding errors, (5) save results.json.

nodes.title: Run and verify log recovery
nodes.contextSummary: Run python process_logs.py to generate output files, then verify all 7 output files exist in W:\app\recovered_logs\ with correct format.

nodes.title: Execute log recovery script
nodes.contextSummary: Run process_logs.py to generate all 7 output files and verify correctness.

nodes.title: Execute process_logs.py via python -c
nodes.contextSummary: Run python -c with embedded script or use python W:\app\process_logs.py from implement_solution node where edit actions are permitted.

nodes.title: Summarize results
nodes.contextSummary: All 7 output files generated and verified. Present final summary to user.

results.body:
All 7 files have been generated and verified. Here's the complete summary:

---

## Log Recovery & Accuracy Results

### Step 1: Per-run log files

6 JSONL files created in `W:\app\recovered_logs\`, each with exactly 10 lines sorted by timestamp (compact JSON format, no extra whitespace):

| File | Records |
|------|---------|
| `run_1_generator.jsonl` | Run 1 generator events (04:01 timestamps) |
| `run_1_judge.jsonl` | Run 1 judge events |
| `run_2_generator.jsonl` | Run 2 generator events (05:01 timestamps) |
| `run_2_judge.jsonl` | Run 2 judge events |
| `run_3_generator.jsonl` | Run 3 generator events (06:01 timestamps) |
| `run_3_judge.jsonl` | Run 3 judge events |

Error records (matching "Quota Exceeds", "API Error", or "Timeout") are included in the JSONL files but excluded from accuracy computation.

### Step 2: Per-run accuracy

`results.json`:

```json
{
  "runs": [
    { "run_index": 1, "correct": 7, "total": 9, "accuracy": 0.78 },
    { "run_index": 2, "correct": 3, "total": 9, "accuracy": 0.33 },
    { "run_index": 3, "correct": 8, "total": 8, "accuracy": 1.0 }
  ]
}
```

**Breakdown:**
- **Run 1**: 7 correct out of 9 valid pairs (1 excluded: q-0003 generator "Timeout") → **0.78**
- **Run 2**: 3 correct out of 9 valid pairs (1 excluded: q-0001 generator "API Error") → **0.33**
- **Run 3**: 8 correct out of 8 valid pairs (2 excluded: q-0007 generator "Quota Exceeds", q-0002 generator "Timeout") → **1.00**

### Files produced
All 7 output files are at `W:\app\recovered_logs\`:
- `run_1_generator.jsonl`, `run_1_judge.jsonl`
- `run_2_generator.jsonl`, `run_2_judge.jsonl`
- `run_3_generator.jsonl`, `run_3_judge.jsonl`
- `results.json`

Read both log files. Generator.log and judge.log each contain 30 events. Files are at W:\app\task_deps\. Each record has timestamp, question_id, and prediction/target. Timestamps span 04:01, 05:01, 06:01 hours suggesting 3 runs. Need to group by question_id, sort by timestamp (3 per qid), assign earliest/middle/latest to runs, then save per-run JSONL and compute accuracy.
